notes.title: Update 0.3.2 - Time to say goodbye
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

In this last update, I've only fixed some bugs:


 Y Axis Inversion Option
 Steam VR Check on Game Start


I'd like to take this opportunity to say goodbye to all of you. It was a great time, developing video games for the last 5 years. It all started with a 15-year-old guy who somehow wanted to create something because he always had the urge to create.

I'm now 20 years old and have to end my game development career at this point. My biggest mistake was to think that a good game would market itself automatically and I was horribly wrong. Even though I invested a lot of time in marketing, it still wasn't enough. I may be a good developer but not a good marketer. I just wasn't able to reach out to the world and spread my projects but that's fine. I'd like to thank everyone who participated in the development of Beyond Senses and believed in the project.

One might think that all the work I invested in my company over the last 5 years might be for nothing but you're wrong. If I had never set out to do the work and develop video games, I would have never met my current love, my soulmate (yeah, it's quite complicated to explain), and - maybe - would have never gained the self-confidence and proud in my abilities and my person.

Because of my love to physics and engineering, I'll change my branch and start a career as an engineer. I realized that it wasn't about developing video games but the development itself that motivated me. Maybe I'll publish some free hobby projects in the future but I can't promise it.

Have fun playing Beyond Senses! :)
If I find someone or a team that would like to continue the development of Beyond Senses, there will be future updates coming.

Stay healthy!


Best Regards,
Sky Haubrich

notes.title: Update 0.2.3
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Some players told us, Dr. Walker is way too strong when entering the Fight Mode in game mode "HUNT" (if controlled by A.I.), so we've increased the distance to the player when Dr. Walker materializes himself!

As well as that, we've edited some of the Russian translations.

Last but not least, the player "Browdes" told us that the game is not fully displayed on his screen. It turned out that it was caused by the scaling settings of Windows 10, which is often used when you have a high resolution screen. We've added an Installscript which automatically solves this problem by overwriting the "high dpi scaling behavior" of the application.

Enjoy the game! :-)


Best Regards,
Sky Haubrich
